summary: McDonald's Midden Limburg en Maastricht Centrum is de meest innovatieve McDonald's organisatie van Nederland, founded in 1989. Type: listed company. About 12 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Family-run McDonald's franchise with restaurants in Weert, Roermond, Echt and Maastricht; flexible shift work open to students.

culture.text: Owned and run by the Slenders family, with over 600 staff serving more than 9,000 guests a day across Limburg restaurants.
Calls itself an inclusive employer welcoming everyone from returners to academics and working students, with training at every station.
Offers flexible morning or night shifts and a Management Curriculum from trainee to Restaurant Manager, which takes about 4.5 years on average.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor through McDonald's Nederland B.V.
All 3 current jobs here (entry-level, in Echt, Panningen and Venlo) are listed as not requiring Dutch.
Its LinkedIn page is written in Dutch, so day-to-day work is likely in Dutch.
